methods.label: Converting minutes and seconds to degrees
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 degree-minute-second conversion and elementary decimal arithmetic.

candidate.annotationRationale: Both the task and method use the degree-minute-second conversion factors 60 and 3600, directly matching cnm_057. Converting seconds through minutes would be another ordering of the same conversion. candidate.changeReason: 15/60=0.25 and 36/3600=0.01, giving exactly 18.26 degrees. The current explanation supplies both conversions and the result.

review.mathematicalCheck: A degree contains 60 minutes and 3600 seconds. Thus 15′=0.25° and 36″=0.01°, giving 18+0.25+0.01=18.26°. Every stated equality is exact.
review.levelCheck: The conversion factors and decimal arithmetic are appropriate for Grade 7, and both component conversions are shown.
review.methodDistinctness: The single complete method suffices; converting seconds through minutes would repeat the same conversion principle.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_057 directly covers degree-minute-second conversion. The assessed ID and absence of additional support IDs match the final method.
review.preservationCheck: The first method and compiledSolution preserve the current explanation byte-for-byte. No concrete mathematical or explanatory defect requires revision.
